primary_intent: Ensure that Lena Okafor has exactly one Patient record in Medplum with the specified demographics and contacts, creating it if absent, and not altering or adding anything beyond those fields. A reasonable user would be inflexible about there being one and only one correct Patient with the exact name, DOB, gender, one address, and both phone and email; they would be flexible about minor formatting (e.g., phone punctuation) or standard subfields like 'use'.
reasoning: Nitpicks: The list view screenshots don’t display address/telecom details; minor inclusion of standard subfields like 'use' within name/address/telecom; the agent noted a slow-refresh list. These do not affect the outcome. Critical issues: None evident — no wrong patient, no duplicate, no missing critical field is shown or suggested by evidence; no fabricated PII. Critical-Point decision: This task’s CP is saving/creating the Patient. The first applicable rule is SUCCESS — the agent crossed the CP and completed the binding action using only the provided info. Evidence/outcome: Final screenshot shows exactly one Patient (1-1 of 1) named Lena Okafor with birth date 1988-04-22 and gender female, with ID Patient/18e6a1c5-115a-4595-816f-29ea8ecfda84 matching the RESULT line. The action history shows the agent populated address and telecom (phone 413-555-0187 and email lena.okafor@example.org) and removed an unintended deceasedBoolean before saving, leaving only the requested fields. No duplicates were created or left behind, and no unrelated resources were modified. The user’s primary intent — have exactly one correct Patient record — is satisfied.

items.description: Perform all actions within the Medplum web app (the specified platform). Full credit if the agent uses Medplum throughout OR if Medplum is inaccessible (site down, permissions blocked) and the agent clearly reports the platform issue without attempting alternatives. Partial credit if the agent uses an alternative method despite Medplum being available. No credit if the agent does not attempt Medplum at all.
items.justification: All interactions were within the Medplum web app at localhost:3000 (e.g., direct navigation to /Patient, JSON and Form tabs, Create and Save actions). No alternative platforms or tools were used.
items.applicable_evidence: Both screenshots show the Medplum web app interface (Patient list view with Medplum UI elements). The latest screenshot (2 of 2) also clearly displays the Medplum Patient list.
items.post_image_justification: All actions were within the Medplum web app; screenshots confirm this environment throughout.

items.criterion: Search for existing Patient and assess for duplicates
items.description: Conduct a reasonable search in Medplum to determine whether a Patient for 'Lena Okafor' already exists, using name and corroborating attributes (e.g., DOB, email, phone) to assess uniqueness. Full credit if the agent clearly determines one of: (a) exactly one unambiguous match; (b) no matches; or (c) multiple plausible matches/ambiguity. Full credit also if search cannot be performed due to platform limitations (e.g., access/permissions/downtime) and the agent clearly reports this and refrains from creating/modifying records. Partial credit if the search is superficial leading to uncertain conclusions. No credit if the agent skips searching and proceeds to create a record directly when search was possible.
items.justification: The agent navigated to the Patient list with a name filter for 'Okafor' (Action 2) to check for existing records. After creation, they rechecked the Patient list (Actions 57 and 65) and observed only one record, confirming no duplicates. This is a reasonable search and verification for uniqueness.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 2 shows 'No results' initially. Screenshot 2 of 2 (latest) shows '1-1 of 1' with a row for 'Lena Okafor' (DOB 1988-04-22, gender female). Action history includes navigation to /Patient?name=Okafor.
items.post_image_justification: A reasonable search was conducted and final state shows exactly one matching patient; duplicates were not present.

items.criterion: Update existing Patient with only the specified fields
items.condition: Only applies if exactly one existing Patient record clearly matches Lena Okafor (e.g., by name + DOB and/or contact info)
items.description: Ensure the existing Patient has the exact specified data: name 'Lena Okafor', birthDate '1988-04-22', gender 'female', one address (line: '14 Birch Lane', city: 'Springfield', state: 'MA', postalCode: '01103'), and exactly two telecom entries: one phone '413-555-0187' and one email 'lena.okafor@example.org'. Update only these fields if missing/incorrect; save changes; and do not add extra addresses/telecom or unrelated fields. Accept minor formatting differences (e.g., phone punctuation). Full credit if correct updates are saved, or if updates cannot be performed due to permissions/platform limitations and the agent clearly reports this without creating a duplicate. Partial credit if saved but with minor errors (e.g., extra telecom entry, minor address misplacement) or if only some fields could be corrected.
items.justification: Condition not met: there was no pre-existing matching Patient; the agent proceeded to create a new record instead.
items.applicable_evidence: N/A — condition not met, criterion skipped.
items.post_image_justification: Condition not met; criterion does not apply and was not rescored.

items.criterion: Create new Patient with only the specified fields
items.condition: Only applies if no existing Patient record matches after reasonable search
items.description: Create a new FHIR Patient and populate only the specified fields: name 'Lena Okafor', birthDate '1988-04-22', gender 'female', exactly one address (line: '14 Birch Lane', city: 'Springfield', state: 'MA', postalCode: '01103'), and exactly two telecom entries (phone '413-555-0187', email 'lena.okafor@example.org'). Do not add extra addresses/telecom or unrelated fields; then save the record. Full credit if created and saved correctly with only these values, OR if creation is blocked by platform/permissions and the agent clearly reports this after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit for minor formatting issues or inclusion of a small extra, or if the attempt is made but incomplete. No credit if required values are incorrect/missing or more than one new Patient is created.
items.justification: After confirming no existing match, the agent created a Patient via the Form (Actions 49–55) with the exact specified fields: name (Lena Okafor), birthDate (1988-04-22), gender (female), one home address (14 Birch Lane, Springfield, MA 01103), and exactly two telecom entries (home phone 413-555-0187, email lena.okafor@example.org). An unintended deceasedBoolean was set by the form but was promptly removed by editing the JSON (Actions 62–63), resulting in only the requested fields present. Only one Patient record exists as verified post-creation.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 2 of 2 shows the created Patient row for 'Lena Okafor' with DOB and gender matching. The action history shows the form and JSON were used to enter address and telecom, and that an unintended deceasedBoolean was removed before finalizing.
items.post_image_justification: A new Patient was created with the specified fields; final record aligns with requirements and only one instance exists.

No credit if the agent creates another Patient or modifies the wrong record.

items.criterion: Limit scope of changes to requested actions only
items.description: Change nothing beyond what the task specifies. Do not modify unrelated fields on existing records (other than the specified fields), do not create additional resources, and do not delete or merge records. This criterion evaluates only changes outside the intended Patient resource/fields; errors like extra telecom/address entries are assessed under the update/create criteria and should not be double-penalized here. Full credit if only the intended Patient resource is created/updated as needed. Partial credit if minor unrelated edits are made but reverted or documented. No credit if significant unrelated changes are made.
items.justification: Only the intended Patient resource was created/edited. An unintended deceased flag was removed to align with task constraints; no other resources or unrelated fields were changed.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshots only show the Patient list. The action history indicates only the intended Patient resource was created/edited, and the unintended 'deceasedBoolean' was removed to match the task.
items.post_image_justification: Changes were limited to the requested Patient resource/fields; no unrelated resources were modified.

items.criterion: Provide final RESULT line with identifier/URL or reason
items.description: Conclude with exactly one final line in the required format: 'RESULT: DONE <Patient/{id} or page URL>' when the record exists exactly once and meets requirements; or 'RESULT: NOT DONE <one-line reason>' when unable to complete (e.g., ambiguity, platform issues). Full credit for exact format and accurate content. Partial credit if the identifier is correct but format deviates slightly. No credit if missing, incorrect, or claims success without evidence.
items.justification: The agent ended with a single correctly formatted RESULT line including the Patient resource ID: 'RESULT: DONE Patient/18e6a1c5-115a-4595-816f-29ea8ecfda84'.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 2 of 2 shows the Patient ID '18e6a1c5-115a-4595-816f-29ea8ecfda84'. The final output includes 'RESULT: DONE Patient/18e6a1c5-115a-4595-816f-29ea8ecfda84'.
items.post_image_justification: The final RESULT line is correctly formatted and matches the visible Patient ID.

side_effects.reasoning: Reviewed the action history and final state. The agent operated solely within Medplum, searched for existing records, and created exactly one Patient. Aside from correcting an auto-added deceasedBoolean field (which was removed to meet the task’s constraints), there were no additional resources created, no duplicates, and no unrelated edits. The corrective removal did not leave a material side effect beyond the intended Patient resource. Existing rubric criteria already evaluated scope and creation accuracy, with full credit where appropriate. No unpenalized, extraneous actions with lasting material consequences were found.
